prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one production-ready universal card-back illustration for the fantasy card game Sylve, portrait 5:7 proportions.
Primary request: create a single distinctive secret card back shared by ALL creatures and gold rewards. Do not reveal rarity or reward type.
Input image: the provided existing card back is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for the game's painterly dark forest green and antique gold ornamental craftsmanship. Design a new back rather than reproducing it.
Subject: a closed, richly embossed deep forest-green leather card, fine antique gold vine border, centered mysterious symmetrical botanical seal of intertwined leaves and a small luminous ivory rune, tasteful softly glowing magical dust inside the border. Premium hand-painted fantasy game asset, tactile materials, sharp silhouette, readable when small.
Composition: exactly one flat straight-on upright rectangular card with subtly rounded corners, filling the portrait canvas; symmetrical balanced border and centered seal, no perspective, no other objects. All exterior space outside the rounded card is truly transparent.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, characters, coins, gems, rarity colors, labels, weapons or identifiable creature; no watermark. The image must look equally appropriate for a common, rare, epic, legendary or gold reward. Preserve clean alpha at card edges.
